exploration_assessment.new_validation_method: Six full-frame candidate renders under two light setups were read, then the image branch was retained. A crop-sheet attempt failed.
exploration_assessment.explanation: The branch executed three materially different shader paths, not merely parameter changes. Observed comparison consists of individual image Reads followed by selection; no crop-based or numerical comparison or explicit highlight analysis is recorded.

failure_or_stopping_observations: Crop sheet creation failed with ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'PIL' (sdk_events.json event 28); the final Blender render and scene save occurred before that failure (final execution stdout.log).
The final render itself was not separately read in the trace; the corresponding original-light image candidate was read. File existence and PNG dimensions were checked at events 30–31.
No documented numerical or crop comparison, edge/stretching assessment, or inference about moving highlights is present.
The final image texture is generated and mapped to an actual countertop mesh, not a full-reference image plane.

candidate_knowledge.problem: Countertop surface reads too uniform relative to reference.
candidate_knowledge.observed_defect: Guidance describes faint straight marks rather than broad flowing pale-gray variation; baseline has a constant material and separate straight rods.
candidate_knowledge.cause_hypothesis: Uniform base color and sparse rods may not reproduce continuous variation; highlights are a competing explanation, not established cause.
candidate_knowledge.executed_method: Replace rods with a counter-specific generated image texture; also render directional noise color and roughness-only alternatives at two light positions.
candidate_knowledge.applicability: Potentially useful for art-directed elongated surface markings on a modeled counter; cross-scene transfer untested.
candidate_knowledge.verification: Six full-frame candidate images read, image branch selected, packed final image recorded in evaluator state. No crop sheet or quantitative match.
candidate_knowledge.side_effects: Mapping may stretch at edges; lighting changes can alter overall brightness. These effects were not explicitly evaluated.
candidate_knowledge.unvalidated: Reference material mechanism, accuracy, side effects and transfer remain unknown.

limitations: Reference and final framing and lighting differ; there is no hidden ground-truth material or geometry.
Evaluator state and target geometry establish scene facts only, not student checks or independent regeneration.
The inherited camera, lighting and scene construction are not new branch discoveries; final source contains unselected branches that are not retained shader nodes.
Packed generated image is not an external asset, so external texture packaging is not credited. No separate directional texture warp is credited for the noise shader.
